Complete-only RMG; no Dreamcast RMG compiland or type procedures. Retail 0x530e90 constructs the vector at +0, zeros its pointer triplet at +4/+8/+0xc and calls clear at 0x530f10, with the matching constructor EH cleanup.

Complete-only RMG; no Dreamcast RMG compiland or type procedures. Retail vtable 0x6409cc slot 2 points to 0x532200: indexes 0x30-byte cells by y*width+x and replaces the eight-bit frame at bits 6..13 of +0x24; ret 8 confirms the two arguments.

Complete-only RMG; no Dreamcast RMG compiland or type procedures. Retail vtable 0x6409cc slot 4 points to 0x532260: extracts terrain/frame from cell +0x24 and flip bits 15/16 from +0x28 into the hidden three-dword result.

Complete-only RMG terrain rule; no Dreamcast RMG compiland or type procedures. Retail vtable 0x642c98 slot 4 points to 0x5b3890: preserves zero-tagged old entries, otherwise selects the primary/secondary range using strength*value/8 and rand, then returns an index within that range.

Complete-only RMG terrain rule; no Dreamcast RMG compiland or type procedures. Retail vtable 0x642c98 slot 5 points to 0x5b38f0: preserves an old entry with the requested transition or samples its range, copies the two-byte requested flip to the output, and returns with ret 0x10.

Complete RMG terrain point comparison has no Dreamcast procedure counterpart; TRmgGridPoint is a provisional name for the two-unsigned-dword coordinate record. Retail 0x5b8ca0 takes point addresses in ECX/EDX, first compares their +4 y fields at 0x5b8ca7 using unsigned jb, then compares x only when y is equal at 0x5b8cb1. It returns zero or one with plain ret. The retained free comparator sits in the rmg_terrain.cpp set-support cluster and is called by terrain painting at 0x5b4e96; it is not a copied STL tree implementation. Generic coordinate ownership is a Complete/x86 inference: the unsigned specialization preserves the retained constructor/comparator ABI and restores the tree insertion exception frame without inline or throw specifications.

Complete RMG geometry has no Dreamcast procedure counterpart; TRmgVector and the point type names remain provisional. Retail 0x5fceb0 is the retained vector-length member used by the irregular zone-boundary painter. It squares both signed integer components at 0x5fcebd/0x5fcec2, adds them at 0x5fcec5, converts the integer sum with fild at 0x5fceca, calls sqrt at 0x5fced8 and the floating-to-integer conversion at 0x5fcee0, then returns without popping arguments. The ordinary support body is in rmg_support.cpp; it is not a header inline inferred from its first emitter.

Complete RMG geometry has no Dreamcast procedure counterpart; TRmgVector and the point type names remain provisional. Retail circumcenter builder 0x5fdb40 calls this ordinary member addition at 0x5fdc49. Body 0x5fdcb0 reads the two receiver dwords through ECX and the by-value vector through stack +0xc/+0x10, adds each component, writes the eight-byte hidden result through stack +8, and returns with ret 0xc. It belongs with the other arithmetic bodies in rmg.cpp, in retained address order.

Complete RMG geometry has no Dreamcast procedure counterpart; TRmgVector and the point type names remain provisional. Retail circumcenter builder 0x5fdb40 calls this ordinary member scaling operation at 0x5fdc2f. Body 0x5fdcd0 multiplies both receiver components by the single scalar at stack +0xc, writes the eight-byte hidden result through stack +8, and returns with ret 8. It belongs in the rmg.cpp arithmetic cluster.

Complete RMG geometry has no Dreamcast procedure counterpart; TRmgVector and the point type names remain provisional. Retail circumcenter builder 0x5fdb40 calls this ordinary member division at 0x5fdc36 and 0x5fdc50. Body 0x5fdcf0 uses cdq/idiv separately for both signed components with the divisor at stack +0xc, writes the eight-byte hidden result through stack +8, and returns with ret 8. It belongs in the rmg.cpp arithmetic cluster.

Complete RMG geometry has no Dreamcast procedure counterpart; TRmgVector and the point type names remain provisional. Retail circumcenter builder 0x5fdb40 calls free point translation at 0x5fdc64. Body 0x5fdd20 receives the result pointer in ECX and two eight-byte values on the stack, adds corresponding components, writes the result and returns with ret 0x10. This differs from the adjacent member vector addition ABI and remains an ordinary free body in rmg.cpp.

Complete RMG geometry has no Dreamcast procedure counterpart; TRmgVector and the point type names remain provisional. Retail circumcenter builder 0x5fdb40 calls free point subtraction at 0x5fdbd8 and 0x5fdbf5. Body 0x5fdd40 receives the result pointer in ECX and two eight-byte points on the stack, subtracts right coordinates from left coordinates, writes the displacement result and returns with ret 0x10. This ordinary free body follows translation in the rmg.cpp arithmetic cluster.

Complete-only random-map terrain support; no Dreamcast RMG compiland or corresponding class procedures. Vtable 0x642c98 slot 1 points to 0x5b3840/0xc. The nullary member loads the unsigned count at this+0x20, compares it against zero with cmp/sbb/neg, and returns its nonzero predicate. This is the secondary range count built by the pattern constructor 0x5b3780. Type/method spellings are provisional retail roles.

Pattern constructor 0x5b3780 stores the supplied entry pointer at this+0x10 (0x5b37a2) and builds ranges over eight-byte records. Type/method spellings are provisional retail roles.

Complete-only random-map terrain support; no Dreamcast RMG compiland or corresponding class procedures. Vtable 0x642c98 slot 3 points to 0x5b3880/0x10. Complete-only random-map terrain support; no Dreamcast RMG compiland or corresponding class procedures. Retained 0x5b3dd0/0x6f receives a grid-point reference and cell index with ret 8. It loads adapter this+0, calls adapter vtable slot 4 at 0x5b3de7 with a twelve-byte return buffer, and uses packed-vector begin at this+0x38 plus index*2. Terrain/frame masks 0xf/0x7f and the two flip bits are packed into one word while preserving upper bits via mask 0xc001 at 0x5b3e28; bit zero is set at 0x5b3e30. The same adapter-read/cache-fill operation is expanded in retained getPackedCell 0x5b48d0. Type/method spellings are provisional retail roles.

Complete-only random-map terrain support; no Dreamcast RMG compiland or corresponding class procedures. It tests cache-valid bit zero at 0x5b48ee; on a miss it calls adapter slot 4 at 0x5b48fe and expands the same packed-cell initialization as 0x5b3dd0. It returns the indexed two-byte cell pointer at 0x5b4950..0x5b495a with ret 4. Type/method spellings are provisional retail roles.

column4: Complete-only random-map terrain support; no Dreamcast RMG compiland or corresponding class procedures. Brush paintRectangle 0x5b7690 forwards four unsigned bounds at 0x5b76a6 to retained 0x5b4960/0x1b2. This member forms x+width and y+height (0x5b496f/0x5b497b), walks unsigned grid coordinates, calls paintPoint 0x5b4b20 at 0x5b4a2d for a differing terrain, or selects a base frame via strength helper 0x5b6fd0 (0x5b4a3e) and rule slot 4 (0x5b4a4f). The same-terrain path writes a tile through adapter slot 1 at 0x5b4a6f and refreshes the two-byte cache. Returns with ret 0x10. Type/method spellings are provisional retail roles.

Complete-only random-map terrain support; no Dreamcast RMG compiland or corresponding class procedures. The rectangle painter calls retained 0x5b4b20/0x5cb at 0x5b4a2d. It accepts a grid-point reference, reads configured terrain this+4, calls strength helper 0x5b6fd0 at 0x5b4b33 and terrain-rule slot 4 at 0x5b4b44, writes through adapter slot 1 at 0x5b4b61, and updates the packed cache. It reconciles point sets at this+0x14/+0x24, branches on terrain-rule byte +5 at 0x5b4c03, and calls horizontal/vertical gaps, separated-neighbour checks and queueOtherTerrainNeighbours (first queue call 0x5b4c72). Returns with ret 4. Type/method spellings are provisional retail roles.

Complete-only random-map terrain support; no Dreamcast RMG compiland or corresponding class procedures. Retained 0x5b50f0/0x34e is called from paintPoint at 0x5b4c72 and 0x5b50dd with one grid-point reference. It bounds north/south and west/east probes using point coordinates and painter dimensions +0xc/+0x10, reads terrain through getPackedCell (first call 0x5b5114), and inserts differing-terrain points into the secondary set at this+0x24 (first insert 0x5b513e). Diagonal probes additionally test the selected terrain-rule byte +5, e.g. 0x5b5298/0x5b529f. Returns with ret 4. Type/method spellings are provisional retail roles.

Complete-only random-map terrain support; no Dreamcast RMG compiland or corresponding class procedures. Painter destructor 0x5b76f0 calls retained 0x5b5440/0x626 at 0x5b7745 while draining the primary set. The one-reference member starts with getPackedCell at 0x5b544f and a vertical-gap call at 0x5b545f, combines cardinal gap/repair queries, and paints selected neighbouring points. For disallowed separated neighbours it calls hasSeparatedNeighbours at 0x5b58e4, builds the eight-byte match mask at 0x5b58f8, ranks runs in the direction ring, and calls paintPoint at 0x5b5a15. Returns with ret 4. Type/method spellings are provisional retail roles.

Complete-only random-map terrain support; no Dreamcast RMG compiland or corresponding class procedures. Painter destructor 0x5b76f0 calls retained nullary 0x5b5a70/0x8a7 at 0x5b780f after draining both worklists. It allocates width*height bytes (product 0x5b5a9d), reads terrain through the packed cache while counting edges, calls buildNeighbourKinds 0x5b68a0 at 0x5b5f4d and fastcall selectTerrainTransition 0x5b3e80 at 0x5b5f5b, then checks diagonal transitions through 0x5b6ba0/0x5b6e00. Rule slots 5/4 select transition/base frames at 0x5b60b6/0x5b60d4. Changed tiles are written through adapter slot 1 at 0x5b6104/0x5b6262 and cached before the byte vector is freed at 0x5b62fe. Type/method spellings are provisional retail roles.

Complete-only random-map terrain support; no Dreamcast RMG compiland or corresponding class procedures. RepairTerrainPoint calls retained 0x5b6320/0x107 at 0x5b5491 with a point reference and terrain. It rejects x==0 and x>=width-1 through unsigned branches at 0x5b6332/0x5b6340, probes x-1 and x+1 through the packed cache (retained initializePackedCell call 0x5b6367 and expanded adapter slot 4 call 0x5b63ab), and requires both terrain values to differ from the supplied terrain.
